payload.core_mechanism_summary: Linear search over possible k (starting from 2) by doubling v=2^k, checking if n%(v-1)==0; output n//(v-1) when found.
payload.rationale: The solution performs a simple exhaustive search over a small set of candidate values until a condition is met; none of the specific subtypes match exactly, but backtracking is the most general given, though no backtracking occurs.
